mapper.sql: id, owner_context, object_type, object_id, purpose_code, reference_key, artifact_id, file_version_no, sensitivity_code, status_code, scope_version, version, detached_at, detached_by, detached_reason, archived_at, creator, create_time, updater, update_time, tenant_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO plt_file_reference (owner_context, object_type, object_id, purpose_code, reference_key, artifact_id, file_version_no, sensitivity_code, status_code, scope_version, version, detached_at, detached_by, detached_reason, archived_at, creator, create_time, updater, update_time, tenant_id) VALUES (#{row.ownerContext}, #{row.objectType}, #{row.objectId}, #{row.purposeCode}, #{row.referenceKey}, #{row.artifactId}, #{row.fileVersionNo}, #{row.sensitivityCode}, #{row.statusCode}, #{row.scopeVersion}, #{row.version}, #{row.detachedAt}, #{row.detachedBy}, #{row.detachedReason}, #{row.archivedAt}, #{row.creator}, COALESCE(#{row.createTime}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)), #{row.updater}, COALESCE(#{row.updateTime}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)), #{row.tenantId})
mapper.update: UPDATE plt_file_reference SET file_version_no = #{query.fileVersionNo}, scope_version = #{query.scopeVersion}, sensitivity_code = #{query.sensitivityCode}, status_code = 'ACTIVE', detached_at = NULL, detached_by = NULL, detached_reason = NULL, archived_at = NULL, version = version + 1, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE tenant_id = #{query.tenantId} AND id = #{query.referenceId} AND artifact_id = #{query.artifactId} AND status_code IN ('ACTIVE', 'DETACHED') AND version = #{query.expectedVersion}

UPDATE plt_file_reference SET status_code = #{query.targetStatus}, scope_version = #{query.scopeVersion}, detached_at = CASE WHEN #{query.targetStatus} = 'DETACHED' THEN #{query.occurredAt} ELSE detached_at END, detached_by = CASE WHEN #{query.targetStatus} = 'DETACHED' THEN #{query.actorUserId} ELSE detached_by END, detached_reason = CASE WHEN #{query.targetStatus} = 'DETACHED' THEN #{query.reason} ELSE detached_reason END, archived_at = CASE WHEN #{query.targetStatus} = 'ARCHIVED' THEN #{query.occurredAt} ELSE archived_at END, version = version + 1, updater = #{query.actorUserId}, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE tenant_id = #{query.tenantId} AND id = #{query.referenceId} AND status_code = #{query.expectedStatus} AND version = #{query.expectedVersion}
